idea-plugin.name: curlconverter
idea-plugin.description:
Converts cURL commands to Python and 40+ other languages with the bundled curlconverter — the same converter that powers curlconverter.com — fully offline. Python defaults to curl_cffi (browser impersonation, file uploads via CurlMime); Python (requests) and the other curlconverter targets are in the settings.
  • Editor context menu → Convert cURL to Python (curl_cffi): replaces the selected command, or the one at the caret. In a scratch file, the scratch is switched to .py.
  • Tools → curlconverter → New Python Scratch from Clipboard cURL.
  • Target language, curl_cffi impersonation, engine and warnings: Settings → Tools → curlconverter.
Runs in the IDE's built-in Chromium (JCEF); falls back to Node.js if JCEF is unavailable.
Source, issues and releases: github.com/adw3r/curlconverter-for-pycharm
